invariants: One shell, eleven rooms, one governed intelligence substrate.
Hub is a projection, never a second brain, second database, or shadow authority system.
Every visible control has a real causal path or an honest unavailable state.
No fake data, activity, mail, receipts, verification or learning.
Current concept remains the visual floor; production implementation may improve it but may not flatten it.
UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED and PRODUCTION_PROVEN are distinct states.
room_acceptance_baseline: every visible control is causally bound or honestly unavailable
cross-room links resolve to canonical objects
independent evidence can verify the room
